statement: (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let primes := fun X => (w X).filter Nat.Prime; let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let short := fun (X D : ℕ) => (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D)).sum c))/(X:ℝ); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor ((X:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)); let f := fun (p : ℕ) => if p.Prime ∧ 2 < p then 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 else 1; let twinC := ∏' p : ℕ, f p; Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => short X (D X)) Filter.atTop (nhds (2*twinC/50))) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let primes := fun X => (w X).filter Nat.Prime; let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let long := fun (X D : ℕ) => (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => D < d)).sum c))/(X:ℝ); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor ((X:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)); let f := fun (p : ℕ) => if p.Prime ∧ 2 < p then 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 else 1; let twinC := ∏' p : ℕ, f p; ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ -2*twinC/50 + κ < long X (D X)) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → E X ≤ C * e X) → (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, B < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 短长除数与奇偶 · TP-0039 · 将短主项与长除数余量合成为真素数对
plain_statement.en: New route · Short and long divisors · TP-0039 · Combine short and long divisor estimates to obtain true primes

brief.zh: 在长段给出的尺度上令短段误差和幂污染都小于 κ/3，用恒等式抽取真素数。
brief.en: On the long-divisor sequence bound both the short error and power contamination by κ/3, then extract a pair.
